inspectedImages.observation: Large organized settlement, markets, gate/wall fragments and adjoining small countryside visible. Named-settlement and countryside sizes differ strongly.
Repeated courtyard/house/storage groups, six market stalls and anonymous commoners are readable. No evidence this distance crosses the city LOD threshold.
Same house group and six-stall market composition as Hanseong, with fewer wards.
Siege gate, soldiers, ships and five nearby houses dominate the waterfront; other countryside remains visible beyond the scene.
Defender and attacker soldiers have the same broad figure shape; house-size soldier symbols and intact repeated buildings give little civilian life or damage information.
Previous gate, ships and soldiers disappear; generic house-and-field region appears inland. This is a battle-year-to-following-war-year comparison, not a completed-war reconstruction test.
Core street, courtyard groups and market layout closely match 1450 at the same view.
Core composition repeats Jeonju town wards and the same market/commoner row; sloping ground fragments street surface visibility.
Same capital core appears much smaller while nearby construction/production-size scenes are large.
Zoom enlarges the small capital symbol, but its world-relative size remains much smaller than 1450/1700. No assertion of a crossed LOD threshold.
The island view is dominated by relief grain, commoners, a cart and table; ordinary habitation and maritime circulation are not readable in this view.
Relief is a distinct composition and is not a generic soldier or assembly grid. Named person is a larger instance of the same commoner family.

independentFindings.finding: Regional and early/late Joseon differentiation is weak in visible city compositions.
independentFindings.limit: Repeated grid or simplified geometry is not itself a historical error; exact town street plans are not required.

independentFindings.finding: Nearby events can reduce the capital's entire displayed scale and replace surrounding background availability.
independentFindings.limit: This is event overlap/display allocation evidence, not a proven city LOD transition.

independentFindings.finding: Busan 1592 scene termination removes its scene geometry; surviving wartime settlement/ruin/mobility state is not supplied by that episode.
independentFindings.limit: 1593 is still within the 1592-1598 war. Exact post-battle rebuilding, castle relocation and occupation state need local dated sources.

independentFindings.finding: 1795 Jeju relief is specifically implemented, yet broader island habitation/transport and differentiated recipients are not readable in the supplied views.
independentFindings.limit: Jeju and relief source material exist. Failure to render a ship is not proof ships are unknown: effects.ships is deliberately false and the script warns two same-year episodes are not simultaneous.

independentFindings.finding: A single Joseon role-based figure style is used for 1392-1894 and both sides of 1592 fighting; period/affiliation variation cannot be inferred from the source-linked style note.
independentFindings.limit: The institutional military-dress entry discusses dated changes. It does not by itself justify dating every brimmed hat or every displayed garment as impossible in 1592.

independentFindings.finding: Some ongoing-use packets exist (Bunwon, Tongjeyeong, waegwan); facility persistence cannot be declared entirely absent.
independentFindings.limit: Baegundong/Dosan/Byeolbangjin construction-only packets and narrow background interpolation still justify a per-facility lifecycle audit; this read did not prove every facility missing from every data layer.

localComposerChecks.method: Loaded baseline chronicle-event-scenes.js in memory, replacing module specifiers only with absolute baseline files and bundled Three.js. rows.note: Counts are this fixture's output, not public visible counts or historical force sizes.

mainCorrectionsToPeer: Reject the ungrounded p95 <= 33.3 ms, 30-second and 10-round-trip values as product acceptance criteria; retain measurement method as provisional diagnostics.
Do not turn a broad 1592-1637 work range into one war/occupation/recovery state shared by Busan, Dongnae and Jeolla.
Separate a dated elderly banquet from evidence of ordinary elder care; preserve the separate dates in Tamna paintings.
Keep JO-04/05 as planner/data-supported continuity defects pending dedicated public boundary views, and keep precise Jeju cell suppression and winning Hanseong nearest event unverified.
Split JO-08 figure-role meaning from terrain/road placement because they have different causes and verification.
